name: mod-mmhmm
about: core's Mm-hmm! hat bonus: rare hats from the kit verb get it exactly when they qualify (25 %, a function of the item), on top of their rolled modifiers; a common hat never; the worn hat with it counts crits while a rifle shoots a target dummy (bench). The voice is the modifier's net-synced crit trigger; GameLab is muted, so the sound is not measured. Uses levelup, kit and give cheats: not evidence of play.
